title: Live 12 Addressable-Target Catalogue
description: Static-source extraction of Live 12 device classes and their addressable parameter names, taken from the upstream MIDI Remote Scripts. The catalogue is used by the Phase 2 Gemini-output validator to confirm that every recommended (device, parameter) pair names a real Live 12 target.

source_commit.description: Upstream git commit SHA the catalogue was generated from.

source_files.description: Paths (within the upstream repo) that the AST extractor read. The first entry is the primary `BANK_DEFINITIONS` dict-literal file; subsequent entries contribute `CUSTOM_BANK_DEFINITIONS[<class>] = IndexedDict(...)` subscript assignments. Per-device parameter sets are the union across all listed files.

license_note.description: Attribution and licensing note for the upstream material. No upstream source is redistributed by ASA; only extracted device/parameter name metadata.

generated_at.description: UTC ISO-8601 timestamp when the catalogue was generated.

extraction_notes.description: Notes about what the static extraction can and cannot recover (e.g. min/max/unit/default live on runtime Live.DeviceParameter objects and are not present in static source).

class.description: Live's internal device class name as exposed by the Live Object Model (e.g. `Saturator`, `Eq8`, `GlueCompressor`).

category.description: Coarse device family. Hand-mapped per `class`; defaults to `audio_effect` when the class name does not indicate otherwise.

displayName.description: User-visible Live 12 device name (e.g. `EQ Eight` for class `Eq8`). Hand-mapped; defaults to `class` when the UI label matches the class name.

name.description: Canonical Live parameter name as exposed by the Live Object Model. Catalogue uses these exact strings for `has_parameter` lookups.

type.description: Parameter datatype. Optional — not present in static source; reserved for future enrichment from runtime introspection.

min.description: Lower numeric bound. Optional — not present in static source.

max.description: Upper numeric bound. Optional — not present in static source.

unit.description: Parameter unit (`dB`, `Hz`, `ms`, ...). Optional — not present in static source.

default.description: Default parameter value. Optional — not present in static source.

values.description: For `enum` parameters: the list of allowed string values. Optional — not present in static source.
